newsitem.title: MEXICO: Cambior, Luismin set 2nd-half decision on gold mine.
newsitem.headline: Cambior, Luismin set 2nd-half decision on gold mine.

text.p: Cambior Inc and Mexican miner Luismin, a subsidiary of Sanluis Corp S.A., will decide in second half 1997 whether to set up a pilot mine at their Metates gold prospect.

"In the next half it will be defined if a pliot plant is established...which will allows us to validate our metallurgic studies and define the stages that follow in the project," a Luismin director told Reuters.
Metates, in the northwestern state of Durango, is estimated to have a mineral inventory of 14 million ounces of gold, split evenly between the project partners.
The director, who asked to remain anonymous, said that the definition of the Metates project, earmarked to be an open pit mine, was "advanced."
